description: Published attendance is absent or ambiguous for E002–E008. The >=50 criterion remains unresolved for the Day of Dignity sequence, girls’ caravan, taxi protest, retired-military roadblocks, and Malacatán actions. “Decenas” does not establish a lower bound of 50; “miles” in the electricity retrospective refers to affected residents, not demonstrators.

description: Malacatán E006–E008 concern an electricity outage and private distribution company. The opened report on 21 Feb names no government demand or specific request to the private provider; the later retrospective describes a broader state-management goal but does not clearly attach it to the 27 Feb manifestation. The 24 Feb occupation’s target is not established.
required_followup: Read contemporaneous reporting and official documents under fresh per-request gates; code a state target only where event-specific demand or target is documented.

description: The February 21 route blockade, February 24 substation occupation, and February 27 demonstration are described in one retrospective but their separation, coordination, continuity, or common organizer is unknown. March reporting may document later action but does not establish a single continuous event.
required_followup: Compare dates, organizers, demands, location and observed pauses in contemporary February and March reports; do not merge by shared outage, municipality or issue.

description: Several potentially relevant results remain search-only or have technical retrieval failures: palace protests on Feb 12 (S001–S002), second-day bicycle actions and feminist mobilization (S004–S008), CODECA secondary reports (S010–S011), and additional taxi, veterans, memorial, energy and USAC leads. description: Searches covered national and regional Guatemalan Spanish-language reporting, international Spanish-language coverage, official sources, weekly/date windows, labour/taxi and rural electricity issues, and university leads. description: E001 has one explicit EFE-origin article (S013), a separately bylined Anadolu article with Anadolu photo credit (S015), and a Prensa Libre report (S012). The inspected Anadolu story does not identify EFE or written republication; treat outlet reports as distinct while leaving distinct eyewitness basis unknown.
